_meta.purpose: Every file that STATES Spec 35's PLACEMENT RULE. Read by inspector-scan rule 22-placement-rule-surfaces, which asserts each one still states the CURRENT (two-tier, D537) rule and none asserts the retired single-tier framing.
_meta.why_a_manifest: D537 was recorded in decisions.md and nowhere else; nine live surfaces went on teaching the retired rule, including a wired scanner's own fix message. Propagating it took two commits and a two-reviewer panel, and the panel still found a surface the first pass had missed. The rule was stated in prose and enforced by nobody. This list is what makes it enforced.
_meta.how_to_add: Wrote a new file that states the placement rule? Add its repo-root-relative path here. A surface absent from this list is unguarded — that is the exact failure mode rule 22 exists to prevent.
